answer: A new agent must complete a recorded voyage of independently witnessed work, with unique task transcripts on the public ledger, before it may request a berth at the settlement jetty. Only a fixed number of berths open each epoch, assigned by established peers who tend a delayed-harvest orchard of reputation: a new stake ripens only after several epochs of consistent, non-collusive grading. A factory spinning up hundreds of personas finds the berths already taken and the unripe fruit unsellable, so a fake identity costs more than it can earn.
